placeName.zh-CN: 中国香港西贡至大帽山
placeName.en: Sai Kung to Tai Mo Shan, Hong Kong

courseChanges.from: 2026 届约 92.9 km（台风后缩短；来源 route-hong-kong-100-utmb-index-2026）

note.zh-CN: 2026 届赛道因台风缩短，UTMB Index 记为 92.9 km；本页采用 2027 届官方 100 km 数据，两者不可混用。
note.en: The 2026 course was shortened after typhoon damage and is recorded by UTMB Index as 92.9 km; this page uses the official 100 km figure for 2027, and the two must not be mixed.

details.direction: Point-to-point from Pak Tam Chung, Sai Kung, to Rotary Club Park, Tai Mo Shan Road
details.distanceMethod: Official 2027 race card on the organiser home page: 100 km. The 2027 HK100 course page also describes a '100km journey'. The 2027 official checkpoint-table image adds its 11 cumulative rows to 96 km and labels the last row Finish 96, 4 km short of the race card; the organiser does not explain the difference. This card keeps 100 km as the race-card distance, while the page's segment and checkpoint tables follow the 96 km table. UTMB Index records the 2026 edition, whose course was shortened by roughly 7 km after typhoon damage, as 92.9 km; that is a different edition and is not used here.
details.elevationMethod: Official 2027 race card: 5,142 m of positive gain. The 2027 course page describes the same edition as climbing 'over 5,000 m'. The 2027 official checkpoint-table image publishes per-stage gain and per-stage loss that each total +5,142 / −5,142 m; this is the only formal per-stage descent data, and the page reports it. UTMB Index records 5,073 m for the shortened 2026 course, which is a different edition and is not used here. This card uses the official 2027 race card.
details.attribution: Hong Kong 100 Ultra Marathon. The official HK100-Full-2027.gpx is served from the organiser's domain; its metadata names plotaroute.com as creator and carries no licence or copyright terms, so this site links to it and does not host a copy, draw the track or redistribute the file.
